package: HTSSOP-32-EP-6.1mm, PowerPAD pad-down (TI package drawing DAP0032C)
description: TPA3116D2/TPA3118D2/TPA3130D2 family: stereo filter-free Class-D amplifier with AM avoidance. TPA3118D2 variant (this part, DAP=pad-down package) does up to 2x30 W into 8 ohm BTL on a dual-layer PCB without a heat sink. 4.5V-26V single supply, differential or single-ended inputs, programmable power limit, master/slave sync, short-circuit/thermal/DC/over-under-voltage protection reported on FAULTZ.

pinout.name: MODSEL
pinout.notes: Mode selection logic input. LOW = BD mode, HIGH = 1SPW mode. TTL levels, compliance to AVCC.

pinout.name: SDZ
pinout.notes: Shutdown logic input. LOW = outputs Hi-Z, HIGH = outputs enabled. TTL levels, compliance to AVCC. Hold low at power-up until inputs are stable to avoid nuisance DC-detect faults.

pinout.name: FAULTZ
pinout.notes: General fault reporting (over-temp, DC detect, over-current, over/under-voltage). Open drain. Low = fault. Can be tied directly to SDZ for automatic latch-clear recovery.

pinout.name: RINP
pinout.notes: Positive audio input, right channel. Biased at 3V.

pinout.name: RINN
pinout.notes: Negative audio input, right channel. Biased at 3V.

pinout.name: PLIMIT
pinout.notes: Power limit level adjust. Resistor divider from GVDD to GND sets the limit; tie directly to GVDD for no power limit.

pinout.name: GVDD
pinout.notes: Internally generated gate voltage supply (LDO output, 6.4-7.4V typ). Not a supply pin - do not connect to anything other than its own 1uF X7R decoupling cap and the PLIMIT / GAIN-SLV resistor dividers. Sized for internal use only.

pinout.name: GAIN/SLV
pinout.notes: Selects gain and Master/Slave mode via a resistor voltage divider.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground.

pinout.name: LINP
pinout.notes: Positive audio input, left channel. Biased at 3V. Connect to GND for PBTL mode.

pinout.name: LINN
pinout.notes: Negative audio input, left channel. Biased at 3V. Connect to GND for PBTL mode.

pinout.name: MUTE
pinout.notes: Mute, fast disable/enable of outputs. HIGH = Hi-Z, LOW = enabled. TTL levels, compliance to AVCC.

pinout.name: AM2
pinout.notes: AM avoidance / PWM switching-frequency select bit 2 (with AM1, AM0). TTL logic level.

pinout.name: AM1
pinout.notes: AM avoidance / PWM switching-frequency select bit 1.

pinout.name: AM0
pinout.notes: AM avoidance / PWM switching-frequency select bit 0.

pinout.name: SYNC
pinout.notes: Clock input/output for synchronizing multiple Class-D devices. Direction (in vs out) set by GAIN/SLV (master/slave) terminal.

pinout.name: AVCC
pinout.notes: Analog supply, 4.5-26V. Feeds internal LDOs including GVDD.

pinout.name: PVCC
pinout.notes: Power stage supply, 4.5-26V.

pinout.name: PVCC
pinout.notes: Power stage supply, 4.5-26V. Duplicate PVCC pin - decouple individually.

pinout.name: BSNL
pinout.notes: Bootstrap for negative left-channel output. Connect a 220nF X5R-or-better ceramic cap to OUTNL for high-side gate drive.

pinout.name: OUTNL
pinout.notes: Negative left-channel Class-D output (to speaker / output filter).

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground.

pinout.name: OUTPL
pinout.notes: Positive left-channel Class-D output.

pinout.name: BSPL
pinout.notes: Bootstrap for positive left-channel output. Connect a 220nF X5R-or-better ceramic cap to OUTPL.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground.

pinout.name: BSNR
pinout.notes: Bootstrap for negative right-channel output. Connect a 220nF X5R-or-better ceramic cap to OUTNR.

pinout.name: OUTNR
pinout.notes: Negative right-channel Class-D output.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground.

pinout.name: OUTPR
pinout.notes: Positive right-channel Class-D output.

pinout.name: BSPR
pinout.notes: Bootstrap for positive right-channel output. Connect a 220nF X5R or better ceramic cap to OUTPR.

pinout.name: PVCC
pinout.notes: Power stage supply, 4.5-26V. Duplicate PVCC pin - decouple individually.

pinout.name: PVCC
pinout.notes: Power stage supply, 4.5-26V. Duplicate PVCC pin - decouple individually.

pinout.name: PowerPAD
pinout.notes: Exposed thermal pad. Connect to GND for best system performance; if not connected to GND, leave floating (do not connect to any other net).

decoupling.placement: one bulk capacitor near the PVCC pins at each end of the device (pins 18/19 side and 31/32 side)
decoupling.notes: Section 8.2.2.3: with a well-designed power supply, two 100uF/50V low-ESR caps are sufficient for input/bulk capacitance; low-ESR required for the high-speed switching application.

decoupling.value: 220pF-1nF low-ESR ceramic + 100nF-1uF mid-frequency ceramic, per PVCC connection (each end of package)
decoupling.placement: as close to the PVCC pins as possible; return directly to the IC GND pad
decoupling.notes: Layout Guidelines 10.1 + Detailed Design Procedure 8.2.2.4: X5R-or-better decoupling at each PVCC pin, located near PVCC/GND to minimize series inductance; consider temperature, ripple current, voltage overshoot when selecting.

decoupling.value: high-frequency decoupling capacitor (value not separately numerically stated for AVCC alone)
decoupling.placement: as close to the AVCC terminal as possible
decoupling.notes: Layout Guidelines 10.1 groups AVCC with PVCC for decoupling-capacitor placement guidance; no distinct AVCC value is given in this datasheet.
Pin-function table: GVDD must not be used as a supply or connected to anything other than this decoupling cap and the PLIMIT / GAIN-SLV resistor dividers.

decoupling.placement: each BSxx pin to its corresponding OUTxx pin (BSNL-OUTNL, BSPL-OUTPL, BSNR-OUTNR, BSPR-OUTPR)
decoupling.notes: Pin-function table + section 8.2.2.5 (Select Bootstrap Capacitors): required to supply high-side output FET gate drive.

land_pattern.package: HTSSOP-32 PowerPAD pad-down, TI drawing DAP0032C (4223691/A, 05/2017)
land_pattern.notes: From the DAP0032C recommended land pattern (package outline pages, TI lit 4223691/A + 4225303/A generic view): body 11.1/10.9mm x 6.2/6.0mm, 1.2mm max height, 30x 0.65mm lead pitch, 32x lead pads (1.5 x 0.45mm each), overall pad-row span (7.5mm) per the board-layout drawing. Exposed thermal pad land: nominal 3.04 x 3.74mm (min/max range 2.46-3.04mm x 3.16-3.74mm per the package outline); note 9 on the land-pattern drawing: 'size of metal pad may vary due to creepage requirement'. Thermal vias in the pad shown at (0.2mm TYP) diameter on a (1.2mm TYP)/(1.3mm TYP) grid - grid pitch is stated but an explicit via count is not; datasheet points to TI app notes SLMA002 and SLMA004 for the thermal-pad/via design itself. Stencil (EXAMPLE STENCIL DESIGN, note 8: 'package is designed to be soldered to a thermal pad on the board'): exposed-pad aperture options by stencil thickness - 0.175mm->2.57x3.16mm, 0.15mm->2.78x3.41mm, 0.125mm->3.04x3.74mm (shown/nominal), 0.1mm->3.40x4.18mm; 100% printed solder coverage by area recommended over the exposed pad. Signal-pad solder mask is non-solder-mask-defined per the package drawing's solder mask detail.

layout_notes: PowerPAD (pin 33, exposed thermal pad) should be connected to GND for best system performance; if not grounded, leave floating rather than tying to another net (pin-function table).

This DAP (pad-down) package is designed to be soldered to a thermal pad on the PCB with thermal vias in the exposed pad; the datasheet defers the via-array design itself to TI app notes SLMA002 and SLMA004, it does not give a via count in-line.
High-frequency decoupling capacitors should be placed as close to the PVCC and AVCC terminals as possible.
Large bulk PVCC decoupling capacitors (100uF or greater) should be placed near the device on the PVCC supplies, one near the PVCC pins at each end of the package.
Local, high-frequency PVCC bypass capacitors should be placed as close to the PVCC pins as possible and can connect directly to the IC GND pad for a low-inductance ground return.
At each PVCC connection (each end of the chip), add a small low-ESR ceramic cap (220pF-1nF) plus a larger mid-frequency ceramic cap (100nF-1uF).
Grounding: all grounds should be connected at the IC GND pins, used as a central/star ground point for the device; PVCC decoupling caps connect to this GND.

Keep the current loop from each output through its ferrite bead (or LC filter) and its filter capacitor back to GND as small and tight as possible - loop size sets the loop's effectiveness as an EMI antenna.
The ferrite-bead or LC output filter should be placed as close to the OUTxx pins as possible for best EMI performance; filter capacitors used in either filter type must be grounded.

Bootstrap capacitors (220nF, 25V, X5R or better) connect each BSxx pin directly to its corresponding OUTxx pin (BSNL-OUTNL, BSPL-OUTPL, BSNR-OUTNR, BSPR-OUTPR) for high-side gate drive; keep these connections short.
GVDD (pin 7) must only carry its own 1uF X7R decoupling cap and the PLIMIT / GAIN-SLV resistor dividers - it is not a general-purpose supply and is sized only for internal loading.
Optional EMI improvement: RC snubber network from each Class-D output to GND, suggested 18ohm in series with 330pF; keep the snubber layout tight and return it directly to the IC's GND pins.

Thermal: RthetaJA = 22 degC/W for this device's DAP-32 package (vs 14 degC/W for the DAD/pad-up package with a top heat sink, and 36 degC/W for the DAP-32 TPA3130D2 variant); psiJT = 0.3 degC/W, psiJB = 4.7 degC/W for TPA3118D2 DAP - the exposed pad is the primary heat path in this pad-down, no-top-heat-sink configuration.

Hold SDZ low at power-up until input signals are stable, and match the impedance seen at the positive and negative inputs, to avoid nuisance DC-detect faults - relevant to the input-network component placement, not just the IC itself.

abs_max.param: Maximum slew rate, AM0/AM1/AM2/MUTE/SDZ/MODSEL (100kOhm series resistor needed if exceeded)
Thermal trip point (not abs-max table, but a hard protection limit)
